implementation_summary: Reviewed the highest-risk files of the verified Website Audit tasks, the cross-task seams and the wizard import rule. No blockers; 1 major (Hindi documents mix Hindi labels with English per-builder wording), 5 minor, 3 info. Not reviewed line by line: the rest of audit/ai, the renderers, edits.ts, the other store modules, key-resolver.ts/beta.ts, the DOC-104/105 ADRs and the QA-700 tsconfigs.

tests_executed.name: focused vitest (doc builders/render, broken links, analyse-site, host pacer, AI timeout, route access)

findings.title: Hindi documents mix Hindi labels with English per-builder wording
findings.recommendation: labelsFor('hi') returns the Hindi table, but the wording tables only have en/ta and fall back to English (structure.ts:77, content.ts:121, findings.ts:48, pitch.ts:61, owner-audit.ts:63, roadmap-document.ts:42, proposal.ts:52, settings.ts:58). Language 'hi' gives a document marked 'hi' with Hindi headings and English body, Proposal and opt-out text. Add hi entries or move this wording into DocumentLabels so the type enforces it; until then report a fallback for hi; add a builder test that renders hi.

findings.title: betaLabel is never used; beta-language documents carry no 'Beta translation' label (Q-45)
findings.recommendation: Add a note block from betaLabel(doc.language) in each builder or renderer, and test it for hi.

findings.title: Page language detection has no Devanagari; the wizard keeps a separate, different script table
findings.recommendation: Add Devanagari to SCRIPT_TABLE (the fixture hi/index.html currently reads as not-identified) and share one script table with packages/wizard/src/screens/audit/results/analysis-text.ts:129.

findings.title: Wizard copies values from @qa/types/@qa/core instead of importing them through browser.js
findings.recommendation: Export AUDIT_AI_STAGES, AUDIT_AI_API, STAGE_MODEL_SLOT, PROPOSAL_PLACEHOLDERS (move it into types) and the crawl limit bounds from packages/types/src/browser.ts; delete the copies (stage-models-api.ts:15-42, settings-api.ts:33, audit-start-form.ts:30-38) and their comparison tests, including the regex one.

findings.title: Wizard and the Structure document use different link-region order and labels
findings.recommendation: Wizard order is menu, footer, breadcrumb, internal; structure.ts:85 is menu, breadcrumb, footer, internal. Labels also differ (Breadcrumb/Breadcrumbs, Internal link/Links in the page content, two placedBy labels). Share one English label set and order through browser.js.

findings.title: Broken-link fetch contract allows following redirects into Skipped Pages
findings.recommendation: checkLinks checks only the first address against Skipped Pages. The comments say makeOutboundFetch (5 redirects by default) and the crawl's siteFetch also follows 5 (crawl.ts:142-148). Require makeCheckerFetch() with its default of 0 redirects (3xx returned as the response), say so in AnalysisInput.fetch and broken-links.ts:9,23, and test a redirect into a skipped area.

findings.title: requestSignal never clears its timer or abort listener after success
findings.recommendation: Return a cleanup, or clearTimeout and remove the listener in a finally in each provider's complete(); otherwise listeners pile up on a long-lived caller signal shared by many AI calls.

findings.title: HelperPermission redeclared in the runner
findings.recommendation: Import HelperPermission from @qa/types (website-audit.ts:864) instead of redeclaring it.

findings.title: Outbound pacer covers the first-hop host only
findings.recommendation: Redirect hops to the www twin or another host are not paced; pace per hop inside safeGet or document the limit.

risks: Only part of the 49-task scope was read line by line; the files listed as not reviewed in implementation_summary may still hold issues.
handoff: BE-501/BE-503/BE-504/BE-505/BE-502 need a correction for the Hindi wording tables and the beta label (findings 1-2). BE-302 for Devanagari. FE-300/FE-400/FE-501/FE-200 for the copied values and wording (after browser.js exports them). BE-305/BE-308 for the fetch contract. BE-401 for timer cleanup.
